allocations_period_check.name: allocations_period_check
allocations_period_check.value:
("allocations"."granularity" = 'WEEK' and "allocations"."period_start" = "allocations"."week_start" and "allocations"."person_days" <= 7) or
      ("allocations"."granularity" = 'DAY' and "allocations"."period_start" >= "allocations"."week_start" and "allocations"."period_start" < "allocations"."week_start" + 7 and "allocations"."person_days" <= 1)

pages_kind_shape.name: pages_kind_shape
pages_kind_shape.value: "pages"."kind" = 'DOC' or ("pages"."parent_id" is null and "pages"."depth" = 0 and not "pages"."is_charter" and not "pages"."locked" and "pages"."title" = '')

tasks_dates_check.name: tasks_dates_check
tasks_dates_check.value: "tasks"."due_date" is null or "tasks"."start_date" is null or "tasks"."due_date" >= "tasks"."start_date"
